name: keyz-claude-skills
description: Claude Code plugins by Kieran Evans.

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adds an adversarial-review skill that looks for the reasons a plan, design, diff or decision will fail, ranks the concerns by a fixed severity bar, and ends with one verdict.

plugins.name: quota-guard
plugins.description: Shows Claude your 5-hour and 7-day subscription quota on every prompt, warns when it runs low or will run out before reset at the current pace, and asks before spawning sub-agents or workflows when it is nearly used up.
